title: Documentation contract follow-ups
description:
Own the implementation work filed by the exhaustive documentation audit where a volatile fact lacks an authoritative projection or the documented contract conflicts with the product. This is follow-up delivery, deliberately separate from the completed documentation-audit epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the ten filed follow-up issues is a direct dependency of this epic and retains an independently verifiable completion gate.
- [hard] REQ-02: The work resolves the audit-recorded documentation contract gaps across CLI schema, event and storage semantics, validation, toolchain policy, gates, and runtime defaults.
- [hard] REQ-03: This epic is a direct dependency of the v1.0 milestone, so release readiness reflects the outstanding follow-up work.

## Scope

The child issues are authoritative for implementation detail. The original audit filing record is 6d82de03; the completed audit epic is 2d109173.
